name: 11790 · Stony Brook, NY
findings: ZIP 11790 (Stony Brook) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11790 (Stony Brook) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11790 (Stony Brook) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).
